name: @ziee/test-e2e
description: Layer-B end-to-end scaffold for ziee-SDK apps: a parameterized Playwright preset (server + desktop variants), the Postgres-docker global-setup/teardown (per-run isolation + server/UI warmup + first-run setup hook), a generic port allocator, and the i18n-safe data-testid selector helpers. The app supplies its specs + fixtures; this package supplies the reusable scaffold via one E2EConfig seam.
